title: Evaluation Measures for Quantification: An Axiomatic Approach
reasoning: The paper analyzes mathematical and methodological properties of quantification evaluation measures (e.g., Identity of Indiscernibles, Non-Negativity, Strict Monotonicity, Maximum, Impartiality, Relativity, Absoluteness, Independence). It does not evaluate or benchmark ethical, moral, or religious aspects of systems or their outputs.
